data.narrative:
Aclarity is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Julie Bliss Mullen that has raised $14M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of one public company (Linzatech) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here and yields a $28M implied valuation, using a 2.0x step-up multiplier applied to the $14M total raised as a valuation proxy. This reflects typical venture capital return expectations for advancement from Series A to subsequent stages. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points; while eight same-sector peers exist, none meet the narrow filtering criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier classifications needed to establish a statistically reliable median.

The single-method analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $32M, centered on $28M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression result and accounts for typical early-stage uncertainty. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of a narrow-stage peer set and reliance on a single methodology. A stronger valuation thesis would require either additional Climate & Energy peers at Series A or A/B stages, or comparable transaction data from the sector.
